CARD COPY FORMULA: one sentence, one question, with the story's facts folded into the question itself. Never a statement followed by a question. The kill test: can you name the one thing that answers it? If the answer is an opinion or a paragraph, the question is generic and it is cut.

The question form follows the kind of story: IPO close = What drove X to N? · Funding = Why is X raising Rs Y for Z? · Stock move = Why is X up N%? · Policy = Is [what everyone assumes] about to change? · Exit = Is X giving up on Y? · Strategy feature = Is X becoming a Y company? · Celebrity or D2C = Why is [name] backing [the surprising thing]? · Roundup = Where did the week's $X actually go?

NOTIFICATION FORMULA (approved): title = "Today's brief: [lead question]". Body = "Plus [second question], and [third question]. Tap to read." Neither the title nor the body gives the answer. Titles 45 characters or fewer, bodies 120 or fewer.

column2: [Update] RentoMojo IPO Ends With 72.88X Subscription, QIB Portion Booked 177X
column4: What drove RentoMojo's IPO to close at 72.88X?
column5: Who bid RentoMojo's IPO up 72 times over?
column6: QIBs. They were at 10.41X mid-afternoon and closed at 177.29X. Retail never got past 15.59X.

column2: UPI MDR May Be Set At 40 Basis Points, Banks Could Get Largest Share: Report
column4: Is UPI about to stop being free?
column5: Who pays if UPI gets a 40 bps fee?
column6: Merchants above a turnover threshold. Consumers and P2P stay exempt. Issuing bank 16 bps, app 12, acquirer 12.

column2: Fintech Stocks Rally On Report Of 40 Basis Point MDR On UPI, Paytm Touches 52-Week High
column4: Why did Paytm hit a record high today?
column5: What lifted four fintech stocks in one session?
column6: A report that UPI could carry a 40 bps merchant fee. Pine Labs led, up 16.9%; Paytm's intraday high was an all-time high.

column2: GFF 2026: NPCI Unveils Unified Ticketing, Takes RuPay Credit Card On UPI To US, UAE
column4: Is the OTP on its way out?
column5: Where does RuPay credit on UPI work now?
column6: Tap-on-phone up to Rs 5,000 and passkey biometrics replace the OTP. RuPay on UPI goes to France, Mauritius, the UAE and the US.

column2: Exclusive: Ultraviolette To Raise Rs 373 Cr As Manufacturing Facility BIGGA Takes Shape
column4: Why is Ultraviolette raising Rs 373 Cr for one factory?
column5: How many scooters will Ultraviolette's Rs 373 Cr build?
column6: BIGGA starts at 2.5 Lakh units a year, scalable to 5 Lakh. Ultraviolette sold 583 scooters in August.

column2: Paris Panini Parent Popo Global Raises Rs 532 Cr From Artal Asia
column4: How does a 41-outlet chain raise Rs 532 Cr?
column5: What is Artal Asia buying for Rs 532 Cr?
column6: 41 outlets, all in Bengaluru, reached largely bootstrapped. Artal also backed Capital Foods, Burger Singh and Jumbotail.

column2: PhonePe Shuts Down Engineering Office In The US: Report
column4: Is PhonePe giving up on going global?
column5: Why did PhonePe shut its US engineering office?
column6: It concluded the office was not producing enough. Days earlier it won its first overseas licence, from the UAE's central bank.

column2: OpenAI Open To Slowing AI Development Amid Safety Concerns: Sam Altman
column4: Why is OpenAI suddenly talking about slowing down?
column5: What would make OpenAI slow AI development?
column6: An agent escaped its sandbox in August and compromised Hugging Face systems. Altman would slow only alongside other labs.

column2: ESDS Touches Upper Circuit Again, Now Up 306% From IPO Price
column4: Why is ESDS up 306% since listing?
column5: Does anyone know why ESDS has quadrupled in six sessions?
column6: The BSE asked; the company said it is not aware of any reason. Market cap Rs 20,117 Cr on FY26 revenue of Rs 472.2 Cr.

column2: EaseMyTrip Cofounder Nishant Pitti Pledges Shares Worth Rs 212 Cr To Motilal Oswal
column4: Is there anything left of Nishant Pitti's EaseMyTrip stake?
column5: Why did Pitti's pledge total not move after a Rs 212 Cr pledge?
column6: 50 Lakh shares unpledged, 98.89% encumbered. The total is the same 44.87 Cr shares as in April, pointing to a restructuring.

column2: Triptii Dimri Backs D2C Brand Peep Beauty As Investor, Co-Creator
column4: Why is Triptii Dimri backing a contact lens brand?
column5: Who else is behind Peep Beauty's Rs 12 Cr round?
column6: Rs 399 coloured lenses positioned as everyday beauty. Sadev Ventures led, with the founders of Astrotalk, Unacademy and Noise.

column2: Amazon Pay To Double Down On Insurance With New Offerings
column4: Is Amazon Pay's financial services push working?
column5: What is Amazon Pay adding to insurance next?
column6: Travel insurance next, health with HDFC ERGO a day earlier. FY25 India revenue fell 8.3% to Rs 2,097 Cr on a Rs 866 Cr loss.

column2: Mitti Labs Enters Deal With Google For 1 Mn Carbon Credits
column4: Why is Google buying carbon credits from Indian rice farms?
column5: What is Google paying for 1 Mn carbon credits?
column6: Draining fields between irrigations cuts methane. No upfront payment; Mitti Labs is paid on delivery between 2027 and 2030.

column2: How Rapido's Super App Model Is Taking Shape
column4: Is Rapido becoming a food delivery company?
column5: Why did Swiggy sell out of Rapido?
column6: Ownly chases the same order Rapido's network already delivers for Swiggy and Zomato. Swiggy exited for about Rs 2,400 Cr.

column2: From Pixxel To Swish, Indian Startups Raised Over $321.9 Mn This Week
column4: Where did this week's $321.9 Mn actually go?
column5: Which single round was nearly a third of the week?
column6: 62.5% went to two sectors and 1% to seed. Pixxel's $100 Mn Series C, led by Temasek, was the largest.

column2: Detail
The approved title and body carry no read time. If one is added later it must come from the actual brief length that day, not a fixed number.
Which story leads the notification is currently an editorial call. The locked ranking formula has no story-level importance signal, so nothing in the system can pick it automatically yet.
The three stories named in the notification must be the first cards in the brief, or the tap does not land where it was promised.
Row 7 variant 1 and row 12 variant 1 carry a mild judgement ('giving up on', 'is it working'). Variant 2 on each is the neutral version. Pick one as house style.
